claims.automatedPass: All listed automated gates completed successfully for the current workspace.
claims.visualEvidencePolicy: Screenshots and pixel signals may support appearance or presence observations only; semantic behavior requires semantic evidence and the named manual scenario.

automatedGates.description: Validate the current/legacy process boundary and tracked process definitions.
Configure release mode and build the canonical workspace targets.
Run the native host, ABI, lifecycle, bridge, and release-boundary tests.
Run the SDK menu-definition generator unit tests.
Prove the checked-in generated example is deterministic and current.
Compile and execute the generated SDK integration fixture.
Validate the machine-readable component and capability catalogue.
Verify the source-built SWF and build metadata hashes.
Exercise canonical/research role and package-integrity tooling with isolated fixtures.
Create and validate the release-role manifest for the canonical product artifact only.
Create and verify the compatibility archive strictly from the canonical release manifest.

manualGates.description: Open from PauseMenu and F2, close and reopen repeatedly, and monitor first-open behavior and crashes.
Exercise keyboard, pointer, wheel in both directions, controller-only navigation, device transitions, and binding capture without leaked or stuck input.
Verify provider callbacks and persisted configuration for edit, Apply, Cancel, dirty close, save failure, and reload/read-back.
Exercise lifecycle contexts and missing, corrupt, incompatible, failing, or disappearing runtime components.
Judge layout, readability, focus, scrolling, glyphs, UI scale, target resolutions, and ultrawide behavior.
Repeat the required scenarios in the isolated baseline and representative heavy/UI-mod profiles.
